text: FIRST-USER ships first. These agreements remain the desired direction while JOURNEYS continues planning and refinement; they do not authorize JOURNEYS execution. Locked transfers: minimal onboarding and first-item activation (24/D), scoped setup facts (42), first-use agent visibility (43), the shared teaching-prototype/upkeep prerequisite (0), and portable guidance/docs reorganization (40).
